'''Veruna''' was one<ref name="EV" /> of three [[moon]]s that [[orbit]]ed the [[planet]] of [[Naboo]].<ref name="Thrawn Alliances">''[[Thrawn: Alliances]]''</ref> It shared its name<ref name="EV" /> with [[King]] [[Ars Veruna]],<ref name="BMF">{{BuildFalconCite|47|Starship Fact File}}</ref> who [[Monarch of Naboo|reigned]] over the [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]] before [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="SWEUE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Veruna first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] and was later identified in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''. In [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' identified the moon as [[Ohma-D'un]].
